rationale.consistency: Uses FlagErrorf/heredoc/httpmock idioms, but getAsset() naming is un-Go-like, create commands restructure RunE while edit commands use a var, and hasDeferredFlags is silently rewritten with changed semantics.
rationale.edge_cases: Covers ext/size/empty/dir/symlink dedupe, '#' in names, 404/422/429; but partial upload failure still posts a body (spec says nothing is written) and default alt strips extension rather than using the file name.
rationale.scope: Re-indents whole RunE bodies in two create commands, alters --parent detection, adds unused UploadStub, unread uploadError fields, possibly unused isSingleImage, and an odd URL-scrubbing hack on errors.
rationale.readability: references.go is ~950 lines of hand-rolled byte-index link parsing on top of goldmark; client.go repeats the same uploadError literal many times; '\\!' degrade logic is opaque.
rationale.robustness: Files and bodies are closed, no obvious panics; but code-span/reference detection is heuristic, error text is scrubbed by string matching, and partial writes leak on mid-batch failure.
rationale.maintainability: Reimplements CommonMark inline parsing instead of relying on goldmark positions, threads uploadErr through every caller, always-true KeepExistingBody knob and dead code add hidden coupling.
